goal: Implement BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules for evaluation and testing without activating them on mainnet
Fixes known consensus flaws including legacy sigop CPU exhaustion, Merkle tree collisions, and timewarp
reviewability: Reviewing the code now is worthwhile as there are no blocking issues
agreement: Substantive support with multiple ACKs across consensus logic and test coverage
Verified by mutation testing across all rules and validating test vectors (instagibbs, ViniciusCestarii)
Tested against independent implementations and BIP test vectors (fametrano, nervana21)
Approved consensus changes while ongoing test reviews continue (optout21, theStack)
Open question on test coverage for caches and mempool reorgs under the new rules (ariard)

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it addresses long-standing consensus vulnerabilities like quadratic sigop DoS and timewarp
Enables upstream testing and evaluation of consensus cleanup rules before any network activation
